coordinate_system: First usable end-effector frame within each sweep. Millimetres. Anatomical LPS mapping unverified; sweep frames differ.
prediction_status: Cached B-mode model refitted on 414 annotations from sweeps 192514, 192619 and 192840. The six other sweeps were not used for fitting. All predictions remain unreviewed suggestions.
browser_preview: Computes trilinear weighted accumulation and Gaussian-normalized compounding from 16/32/64 sampled frames. Distinct from full-sweep 0.3 mm reference exports.

model_training.score_scope: Fitting-image agreement only; all displayed sweeps entered training.

test_sweeps.scope: Unreviewed model suggestions on sweeps without reference masks; no accuracy score.
